name: Dorf Stub'n
beschreibung:
Centrally located in the charming village of Soell, Dorf Stub'n welcomes visitors with authentic hospitality and a rustic atmosphere. Its comfortable rooms and apartments provide a restful retreat for families and mountain lovers.

With direct access to the vast SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental and numerous summer hiking trails, Soell guarantees exceptional alpine recreation year-round.
kurzbeschreibung: Dorf Stub'n in Soell offers cosy alpine lodging and traditional Tyrolean cuisine at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser.
